patch_description: Preserve the current controller during ordinary progress. Detect repeated waits and position–target cycles without exploration, task progress, or route advance. During stalls only, compare low-hazard detours with waiting through a three-step search using learned enemy motion, including collision risk before enemy movement. Penalize recent revisits and repeated waiting while retaining immediate visible-enemy exclusion. Recovery never relaxes its immediate hazard bound merely because time has elapsed. This targets the observed timeouts; its effect on fitness requires evaluation.
